method: Manually compared actual source heads/stems/terminals and neighboring contour owners. No ordinal/count/equal-bin/IoU/pixel-distance match rule. IDs below are explicit authored identifications.

correspondences.source_contour_evidence: Opening high narrow loop has a central crossing and a lower returned loop. It precedes a separate shouldered ascender; both loops belong to the crossed stem rather than the next shoulder.
correspondences.scope: class and local body-owner correspondence only; original approximate bboxes unchanged; no group separator certification

correspondences.source_contour_evidence: Immediately right of the opening crossed loop is a loop ascender returning into a right shoulder. Its lower course joins the short bar form; it has no second lower loop matching the preceding crossed body.
correspondences.scope: class and local body-owner correspondence only; original approximate bboxes unchanged; no group separator certification

correspondences.source_contour_evidence: Between the tall shouldered ascender and stacked lobes, a short top bar bends downward into a lower rounded bowl. The terminal is a bowl, not merely the small foot of the final oblique body.
correspondences.scope: class and local body-owner correspondence only; original approximate bboxes unchanged; no group separator certification

correspondences.source_contour_evidence: Two stacked compact lobes occur after the bar-and-bowl form and before the short oblique terminal. The waist belongs to these lobes, not to the tall preceding ascender.
correspondences.scope: class and local body-owner correspondence only; original approximate bboxes unchanged; no group separator certification

correspondences.source_contour_evidence: Short rising/slanted stroke and lower foot follow the stacked lobes, before a visible space and the next barred tall left-bowl body. No lower rounded bowl or tall ascender is required for this final short form.
correspondences.scope: class and local body-owner correspondence only; original approximate bboxes unchanged; no group separator certification
